svg.title: ThingsBoard 3.6 HTTP Device API: token auth, telemetry, attributes and RPC

g.text: ThingsBoard 3.6 HTTP Device API: token auth, telemetry, attributes and RPC
The device token is part of the URL path, not a user JWT.
Proxy, access and tracing logs must redact it.
It does not wait for Rule Engine consumption or database commit.
GET Attributes with temporary SYNC session
HTTP timeout does not cancel a queued record or continuing Rule Node.
